coverage.count_definition: Generated cases are input combinations, not test-function or assertion counts. They are separate from the 28 frozen fixtures and focused adversarial cases; no aggregate field-scenario count is claimed.
independent_oracles: Duration enumeration directly counts integer intervals between state changes across all 32 five-interval online/offline patterns, seven initial-history choices and nine pairs of minimum durations.
Rate/ramp enumeration compares integer vertex maxima and undivided slope cross-products for 125 three-point traces and five bounds.
Analytical binary64 fractions for native-rounding-hidden gaps, subnormal underflow and overflowing slope are asserted without evaluator internals.

initial_failed_run.provenance: Implementation agent reported the original retained tool output; no separate log file was written. This record preserves its failure details without claiming the independent reviewer directly observed that run.

correction.reason: With initial state absent, opposite-state absence is unproved. Its zero minimum is met under either possible history; not_applicable requires established absence. Frozen protocol lines 62 and 66 resolve the distinction.
